flagged.issue: The structure '이제 그만 + V' means 'stop V-ing now', so '이제 그만 쉴까요?' naturally reads as 'Shall we stop resting now?' (i.e., go back to working) — the opposite of the intended gloss 'Shall we stop now and rest?'. To express 'stop and rest', the standard form is '이제 그만하고 쉴까요?' or '이제 (일은) 그만하고 좀 쉴까요?'.
